Interface Author

All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<Author>
All Known Implementing Classes:
Author.ByName, Author.ByRef
public sealed interface Author extends Comparable<Author> permits Author.ByName, Author.ByRef
The Author interface represents an abstraction of an author entity and provides methods for comparing and identifying authors. This sealed interface allows specific implementations, Author.ByName and Author.ByRef, to model authors by either a name-based or reference-based identifier.
